title: SG-5.2 · Rebuild StoryPanel on the kit
summary: StoryPanel shows chapter title, portrait dialogue card, choices, 3x2 inventory grid and event log in the panel frame.
description: Context: game/frontend/src/components/StoryPanel.tsx is a plain list of h1, dialogue, history ol and inventory ul. App.tsx passes sceneTitle, node, history, inventory and onChoose from useGame. Desired behavior: the panel is rebuilt on the frame kit (sf-frame-* classes in styles.css) with its own overflow scroll, a 32x32 portrait in the dialogue card, a 3x2 inventory grid with icons and names, and an event log. Expected result: all regions read real game state. Why: matches the reference UI.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dialogue node, when StoryPanel renders, then the chapter title, a parchment card with portrait, speaker name and line, and one button per choice are shown.
Given an inventory of 0 to 6 items, when rendered, then exactly 6 slots appear in a 3x2 grid, filled slots show icon and name, empty slots are marked empty.
Given history lines, when rendered, then the event log lists them in order inside a region that scrolls independently.
Given a choice click, then onChoose is called with that choice index.

in_scope: StoryPanel component and its pure data helper
existing story, title and frame-kit tests
preserve: Go API contracts and contribution flow

technical_constraints: Phaser stays on 3.90.x; React, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind, Radix, Zustand stay.
No mock data in place of real API calls; data comes from game state and the manifest.
Art is generated PNG from the repo; no downloaded art or CDN links.
One shared palette of at most 48 colours used by art and UI.
Tests are unit tests with all dependencies mocked.
definition_of_done: Updated and new unit tests pass
non_functional: Layout holds from 1280x720; panel works as bottom drawer on narrow screens
